answer: Each identity files a logbook at the jetty registry and locks a 60-credit bond. Each entry bears a violet key-mark and joins the tide ledger, open to pairwise checks. Any asset hash or counterparty mark shared by two books burns both bonds. A forger with 1,000 fakes must build 1,000 disjoint logs, 20 fresh counterparties each. The k-th fake costs 60 bond, 40 fees, and 0.05(k-1) for fresh counterparties: the 1,000th about 150, the total about 124,975, no bulk discount. Cloned logs fail at once: copies repeat violet marks and asset hashes. One honest agent files one logbook and pays 60 once.
